notes: Visage, coupe au bol brune, lunettes rouges, col jaune et panneaux nylon violets/rose concordent avec les éléments visibles des photos. Nouvelle posture calme, bouche fermée, mains en poches ; nouveau hall orange/chartreuse sans personnage secondaire. Le minuscule signe blanc sur la branche des lunettes du premier natif a été retiré par une vraie édition ImageGen ; branche rouge unie dans le natif retenu. Aucun texte lisible ni arme observé. L’image reste à mi-corps et ne valide pas pieds, jambes ou détails cachés.

notes: Both initial and corrected real native outputs personally viewed. Final preserves the photographed2007 source face/hair/goatee, round ear plug, pendant and charcoal long-sleeved top rather than prior sprite tank top. LEFT hand now holds the complete black microphone calmly near chest, RIGHT arm lowered: distinct from raised pointing/concert pose. True ImageGen correction moved yellow tape from bottom to just below microphone head. Original empty acoustic-balcony background is graphite/cyan and differs from concert LED wall. Complete head and microphone inside frame, torso cropped above hips by design; no shoes, hidden tattoos or lower clothing invented. No third party, readable text, logo, UI or game-character asset observed. Face likeness and source-visible details accepted for independent review with source limitations, not perfect1:1 certification.

notes: Both initial and corrected real native outputs personally viewed. Final preserves authentic2006 buzz cut, visible face proportions, moustache/goatee, light-gray loose T-shirt and skull illustration, LEFT wristwatch and ring. New quiet seated pose has closed mouth, open shoulders and own hands at console edge instead of interviewers microphone/third-party hand. Genuine ImageGen correction removed the legible-looking cursive cluster from the shirt; remaining marks read as abstract illustration/flames rather than writing. Correction also tightened portrait framing: lower portions of hands naturally meet/cross the lower image edge; no claim that both hands are wholly framed. Entire head and torso visible; no unseen footwear or lower-body costume invented. Empty cyan/graphite editing background is an original game adaptation. No other person, logo, readable text, UI or game-character asset observed. Source-based likeness accepted for independent review with limits, not absolute1:1 certification.
